```{r setup}
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = here::here())
source(here::here("R", "00_setup.R"))
dt   <- readRDS(file.path(out_dir, "compiled-data.rds")) |>
  dplyr::rename(lon = longitudestart, lat = latitudestart, year = startyear) |>
  dplyr::mutate(value = .data[[response_col]], month = as.integer(month)) |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(value))
dt   <- sdmTMB::add_utm_columns(dt, ll_names = c("lon", "lat"), utm_crs = dt_crs)
grid <- readRDS(file.path(out_dir, "prediction-grid.rds"))
mesh <- sdmTMB::make_mesh(dt, xy_cols = c("X", "Y"), cutoff = cfg$MESH_CUTOFF_KM)
```

## Model & structure selection

Fit the candidate models, then compare their indices, per-cell prediction differences, and
sanity with `compare_models()`. Remember the assessment use-case when choosing the
spatiotemporal structure: total/length indices use `ar1` and no year effect; the
assessment-selected index often uses `iid` + `year` as a fixed effect (avoids temporal
smoothing).

```{r selection, eval=params$run_selection}
fit_ar1 <- readRDS(file.path(out_dir, "model-fit-total.rds"))     # from Step 2
fit_iid <- update(fit_ar1, spatiotemporal = "iid")
# add / drop terms and families as candidates, e.g.:
# fit_nogear <- update(fit_ar1, formula = value ~ 0 + s(month) + s(depth))
# fit_gamma  <- update(fit_ar1, family = sdmTMB::delta_gamma())

cmp <- compare_models(fit_ar1, fit_iid, newdata = grid, reference_model = 1)
plot(cmp, type = "index")
plot(cmp, type = "spatial")
```

## Mesh sensitivity

```{r mesh-cv, eval=params$run_mesh_cv}
fit_ar1 <- readRDS(file.path(out_dir, "model-fit-total.rds"))
mcv <- sdmTMB_mesh_cv(fit_ar1, mesh_cutoffs = c(40, 60, 80, 100), k = 3)
plot(mcv, metric = "sum_loglik")

mcmp <- compare_meshes(fit_ar1, mesh_cutoffs = c(40, 60, 80, 100), newdata = grid)
plot(mcmp, type = "index")
```

## Retrospective

```{r retro, eval=params$run_retro}
fit_ar1 <- readRDS(file.path(out_dir, "model-fit-total.rds"))
retro <- sdmTMB_retro(fit_ar1, newdata = grid, nyears = 5)
plot(retro)
```

## Decision

State the chosen specification (formula, family, spatiotemporal structure, mesh cutoff,
barrier) and the evidence for it, and record it in `memory/` as a `decision`. Then proceed to
Step 4 (`index-final-report`).
